## What will fight you

The rocker-arm support is modelled as a cast iron casting with 6.35 mm shell walls and R12.7-relieved internal corners; cutting it from bar is a benign substitution. Its four foot holes are 5/16 in drilled clearances through the .25 in (6.35 mm) foot, printed Ø .313 THRU ALL in the sheet's hole table; 1/4-20 hex-head screws pass down through them into tapped seats in the base. The dimensions and drill size come from `cad/scripts/build_fr_rocker_arm_support.py`, `cad/scripts/fr_rocker_arm_support_spec.py` and `cad/scripts/draw_fr_rocker_arm_support.py`.
